prompts.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create ONE portrait Google Play promotional screenshot for Rocksky at 9:16. Image 1 is app UI insert, preserve it faithfully inside a slim black upright front-facing Android phone, all screen visible, exact UI proportions and content. Image 2 is reference for BACKGROUND DESIGN ONLY: copy the gradient style of the share card INSIDE that screenshot: a perfectly smooth flat vertical linear gradient from coral pink #f86486 at top through violet #7b35cb in middle to very dark plum #170b32 at bottom. Add only two extremely subtle oversized thin circular outlines at 8% white opacity, cropped at corners like the actual Rocksky share card. No waves, ribbons, folds, glowing borders, texture, grain, noise, aurora, neon lighting or 3D background objects. Premium restrained editorial style. Large bold clean white heading at top exactly "Discover your next\nfavorite track" in two centered lines; small spaced uppercase ROCKSKY above it, pale yellow #fff2a3. Headline area occupies top 20%, slim phone centered beneath, bottom margin 3%, strong legibility, realistic fine black frame with minimal shadow. Background must feel EXACTLY like the actual app sharing card, smooth and minimal. Only one phone, no extra marketing text.
